patient_overview.name: Morgan Gottlieb
patient_overview.description: Morgan Gottlieb is a 69-year-old man living in Woodbury, New Jersey, with a household of five, who comes in for help managing knee osteoarthritis pain alongside his history of heart disease and bypass surgery. He is quiet and matter-of-fact, tends to minimize his pain and symptoms, and often answers questions with 'whatever you think is best' rather than offering his own preferences. He works full-time despite his knee pain and a long-standing struggle with opioid dependence, and he is motivated to take one clear, concrete step rather than overhaul his whole life at once.

demographics.cultural_context: Morgan grew up working-class in South Jersey and has always measured himself by whether he can still show up for his shift. He left school after high school and went straight into physical labor jobs, which shaped a 'tough it out' attitude toward pain and illness. Food in his house was always simple and filling rather than planned around health, and that habit has stuck with him into his later years, especially now that money is tight and getting to appointments or the store isn't always easy.

medications.name: Acetaminophen 300 MG / Hydrocodone Bitartrate 5 MG Oral Tablet

medications.name: Clopidogrel 75 MG Oral Tablet

medications.name: Simvastatin 20 MG Oral Tablet

medications.patient_concerns: Not worried about it, says his cholesterol numbers are good so 'it must be working'
